title: Anakin Skywalker
subtitle: What it Takes to Win
text: Action [Exhaust, deal 2 damage to your base]: Attack with a unit. If it's attacking a unit, it gets +2/+0 for this attack.
deployBox:
Overwhelm (When attacking an enemy unit, deal excess damage to the opponent’s base.)
This unit gets +1/+0 for every 5 damage on your base.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules: If you use Anakin's leader ability, you must attack with a unit, if able. Units must be ready in order to attack.
